pie: gʰóstipotey gʷegʷómh₂e. dh₃dʰí moy méne suHnúm h₂éti. kʷóm h₂elgʷʰóm kʷinéwesi? pénkʷe h₁éḱwons ḱm̥tóm-kʷe h₂éwis. só ḱuh₁rós déḱm̥ h₁éḱwons h₂élgʷʰeti. déḱm̥ moy h₁éḱwōs ne h₁sénti. h₁áyso me l̥h₁dʰí-kʷe méne suHnúm. h₂éǵe tóns h₁idʰé nésētor-kʷe só tébʰye ḱóm. dh₃ih₁ént toy deywṓs h₁wésuh₂.
english: Lord, I have come. Give me back my son. What price will you pay? Five horses and a hundred sheep. He is strong; he is worth ten horses. I do not have ten horses. Take me, and let my son go. Drive them here, and he will return home with you. May the gods give you good things.

pie: bʰréh₂ter gʷíh₃wesi? gʷíh₃woh₂. h₁esh₂ós me h₂éǵtreh₂h₁ trís kélh₂t. kʷíd te só kélh₂t? wetsós drúsu néḱt. tóm h₂isḱóm tóm-kʷe ne widóm. l̥gʰdʰí. wódr̥ toy bʰérōh₂. mē te widóyh₁t pótis. túH moy h₁sónts bʰréh₂tēr.
english: Brother, are you alive? I am alive. The master struck me three times with the whip. Why did he strike you? A calf was lost among the trees. I searched for it, and I did not find it. Lie down. I will bring you water. May the master not see you. You are a true brother to me.

pie: swésor bʰéwdʰesi? bʰéwdʰoh₂. ǵʰóstoh₁ moy gʷr̥h₂unés Hrupyétes. swépnos moy ne gʷm̥yéti. méh₂tr̥s moy h₁énih₃kʷom memónh₂e. ḱóymom toy memónth₂e? tóm memónh₂e. póyḱōs h₁ím h₁éwsont h₁l̥h₂ént-kʷe me gʷéwbʰis. h₂ewsér bʰéwgowos. tód mē wéwkes. h₁esh₂ósyo ḱwónes h₂ḱh₂owsyónti. ssdʰí mógʰew nu.
english: Are you awake, sister? I am awake. My hands are in pain from the quern. Sleep does not come to me. I remember my mother's face. Do you remember your home? I remember it. The enemies burned it, and they drove me off with the cattle. Let us two flee toward the dawn. Do not say it. The master's dogs hear well. Sleep now, boy.

pie: kʷíd moy ǵérh₂ont ph₂tḗr h₁mé h₁idʰé léykʷt? ph₂tḗr toy twé dʰoHnéh₂h₁ pérh₂t. gʷoldʰós tósyo démi h₁ést kénket-kʷe tósyo téḱneh₂. h₁idʰé gʷémeti? h₁idʰé ne gʷémeti. nu h₁idʰé gʷíh₃wēsi. kʷís moy ph₂tḗr nu h₁éseti? h₁eǵóh₂ toy ph₂tḗr h₁ésoh₂. gʷm̥dʰí stéh₂dʰh₁osyo te wérǵom ḱéHsoh₂.
english: Old man, why did my father leave me here? Your father sold you for grain. Hunger was in his house, and his children were hungry. Will he come here? He will not come here. Now you will live here. Who will be a father to me now? I will be a father to you. Come; I will teach you the work of the herd.

pie: kʷíd mā́dsos péh₂uros? póteys gʰósteyes mḗms h₂ḱh₃ént. h₁yód linkʷénti tód nos dédh₃n̥ti. solh₂wóm dinóm wr̥ǵyóm. úderos moy gʰrémeti. h₁áyso moy bʰoh₂góm. h₁eǵóh₂ ǵérh₂onts gʷr̥h₃óh₂-kʷe péh₂urom. tóm gʷr̥h₃ṓwos. dh₃ih₁ént nos dʰéh₁ses mḗms.
english: Why is the food little? The master's guests ate up the meat. What they leave, that they give to us. I worked the whole day. My belly rumbles. Take my share. I am old, and I eat little. Let us both eat it. May the gods give us meat.

pie: gʰóstipotey sh₁ésō gʷegʷóme. dh₃dʰí moy misdʰóm. kʷóm toy misdʰóm h₁wogʷʰéyom? h₂l̥bʰités bʰólǵʰim káprom-kʷe. h₂érh₃trom moy Hrunéps. kápros h₂érh₃trosyo h₂elgʷʰós. h₂éḱmō tód Hrunépt h₁eǵóh₂ tód ne Hrunépm̥. h₁eǵóh₂ h₁léwdʰeros h₂nḗr. h₁áyso h₂élbʰit litdʰí-kʷe. h₁yód dʰh₁tléh₂i h₁mé próti bʰéh₂esi h₃órbʰōs moy te kélh₂onti.
english: Lord, harvest time has come. Give me the wage. What wage did I promise you? A sack of barley and a goat. You broke my plough. The goat is the price of the plough. The stone broke it; I did not break it. I am a free man. Take the barley, and go. If you speak against me in the assembly, my servants will strike you.

pie: h₁ésh₂e Hrupyési? Hrupyóh₂. móros h₁mé próti gʷm̥sḱéti. wodʰéye moy dʰúgh₂teres h₁idʰé. pótey gʷm̥sḱónti. ḱludʰí moy wékʷos. h₁yód méroh₂ h₁léwdʰeros h₁ésesi. dʰugh₂téres moy tód ḱléwonti meménonti-kʷe tód. pótey mē mérs. kʷís me h₂léksēti? téwe te ǵʰóstoh₁ péh₂setes.
english: Master, are you in pain? I am in pain. Death is coming toward me. Lead my daughters here. They are coming, master. Hear my word. When I die, you will be free. My daughters will hear it, and they will remember it. Do not die, master. Who will protect me? Your hands will guard you.

pie: h₂énHe deywṓs h₃órbʰons ḱlush₁yónti? dʰúgh₂ter deywṓs solh₂wóns mórtons ḱlush₁yónti. solh₂wṓy mórtōy próti ne mluHénti. h₂uséy moy méh₂term̥ gʷʰédʰyom. h₁íh₂ moy h₁íh₂m̥ déh₃eti? dʰúgh₂ter toy méh₂tēr n̥ḱéwih₂. néḱewes ne nésontor. h₂éwsōs te widéh₁yeti h₂léksēti-kʷe te. nu tósyeh₂ey h₂éyeri séngʷʰōh₂.
english: Grandmother, do the gods hear servants? The gods hear all mortals, daughter. But they do not answer every mortal. I prayed to Dawn for my mother. Will she give her to me? Your mother is dead, daughter. The dead do not return home. But Dawn sees you, and she will guard you. Then I will sing to her in the morning.

pie: dʰwórm̥ toy gʷegʷómh₂e. déḱm̥ moy h₂ówins gʷṓm-kʷe dʰl̥gʰési. kúdʰe téh₂es h₁sénti? móros moy h₂ówins sléh₂gʷt h₂ḱh₃ént-kʷe wĺ̥kʷōs gʷṓm. h₁áyso moy ǵʰóstoh₁ h₃épos-kʷe. nu me tísrn̥s ǵʰéyomn̥s sékʷēth₂er. suHnús toy moy káprons péh₂seti. suHnús moy téḱnom. h₁ím h₂élēsi? ḱwónes moy h₁yód linkʷénti h₁éy tód h₁édeti. h₃m̥nh₃dʰí deywóybʰos h₁óytom. h₃m̥néh₃mi.
english: I have come to your door. You owe me ten sheep and a cow. Where are they? The plague took my sheep, and the wolves ate up the cow. Take my hands and my labour. Then you will serve me for three winters. Your son will tend my goats. My son is a child. Will you feed him? What my dogs leave, that he will eat. Swear an oath to the gods. I swear.

pie: kʷíd pótni dʰédʰeh₁oh₂? h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m toy ḱóymoy téks? téksm̥ snéh₁m̥-kʷe. méh₂tēr moy h₁mé ḱéHst. nu téntleh₂ h₁épi sddʰí. dʰugh₂tréy moy téksesi. kúdʰe moy dʰugh₂tḗr h₁ésti? pótis moy h₂élyeh₂s dʰǵʰmés wiHrṓy h₁íh₂m̥ pérh₂t. mē HréwdHs. dáḱruh₂ h₁íh₂m̥ h₂éti ne wédʰēti. pótni te ḱlowséyōh₂.
english: Mistress, what shall I do? Did you weave wool in your home? I wove, and I spun. My mother taught me. Then sit down at the loom. You will weave for my daughter. Where is my daughter? My husband sold her to a man of another land. Do not weep. Tears will not bring her back. I will obey you, mistress.

pie: wíḱpotey toy h₃órbʰom h₂éti wédʰom. h₁éy dréwi Hn̥dʰí kéwdʰeto. kúdʰe h₁éyt? pérwōr. téwkt te? ne me téwkt. HréwdHt sékʷeto-kʷe me. h₁áyso toy ḱóm káprom misdʰóm. dukdʰí tóm h₁mé próti.
english: Chief, I have brought back your servant. He was hiding himself under a tree. Where was he going? Toward the mountains. Did he strike you? He did not strike me. He wept, and he followed me. Take this goat, your reward. Lead him to me.

pie: kʷíd méh₂ter wéy ne h₁léwdʰerōs? ph₂tḗr toy kaptós h₁ést h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe póteys h₃órbʰos. h₃órbʰosyo suHnús h₃órbʰos. kúdʰe moy ph₂tḗr h₁ésti? só m̥ǵh₂és snóygʷʰosyo ǵʰyémi mért. dréh₂t moréyet-kʷe sríHgos tóm pérunsu. éti bʰéwgoh₂ h₁yód h₂wéksoh₂. súHnew tód mē wérh₁s. h₁esh₂ós solh₂wéh₂ ḱlush₁yéti.
english: Mother, why are we not free? Your father was a captive, and I am the master's servant. A servant's son is a servant. Where is my father? He died in the winter of the great snow. He ran away, and the cold killed him in the mountains. I too will flee, when I grow up. Do not say that, son! The master hears all things.

pie: kúdʰe nos h₂éǵonti? h₂élyeh₂m dʰéǵʰōm. h₂élyons h₂én sékʷōmesdʰh₂. dʰéǵʰōm nos h₂éti kʷéḱomes? ne wóydh₂e. stéygʰe mē-kʷe HréwdHs. h₁yéh₂es HrudHénti tā́s gʷʰn̥sḱónti. ḱeḱómh₂h₂e tr̥syóh₂-kʷe. ḱl̥nisó méǵʰye h₁épi. wódr̥ nos déh₂newi déh₃onti.
english: Where are they driving us? To another land. There we will serve other men. Will we see our land again? I do not know. Walk, and do not weep. They strike those who weep. I am tired, and I am thirsty. Lean on me. At the river they will give us water.

pie: ḱludʰí me h₁ésh₂e. septḿ̥ te sémās sékʷoh₂er. sl̥ǵdʰí me nu. kʷís moy stéh₂dʰh₁om péh₂seti h₁yód gʷéh₂esi? déḱm̥ te gʷéwbʰis kʷrinā́m. tód wóydh₂e. méh₂tēr moy ǵr̥h₂éntih₂ h₁íh₂-kʷe somHéh₂. kʷinudʰí moy tóm h₂elgʷʰóm gʷh₂dʰí-kʷe. kúdʰe déḱm̥ péḱuh₂ widṓh₂? nu me sékʷēth₂er méresi-kʷe moy démi.
english: Master, hear me. I have followed you for seven summers. Release me now. Who will guard my herd, if you go? I bought you for ten cows. I know it. But my mother is old, and she is alone. Pay me that price, and go. Where shall I find ten head of cattle? Then you will follow me, and you will die in my house.

pie: kʷíd moy déms bʰéwgs? h₁ésh₂e kénkom. pótnih₂ toy moy mā́dsom ne dédeh₃t. kúdʰe te widónt? déh₂newi. ḱwónes me h₂én h₁pént. h₁yód h₂éti dréh₂esi gʰostíbʰos te pérh₂oh₂. nu toy sh₂imṓ pódh₁e wédʰēti. bʰéndʰe me dh₃dʰí-kʷe moy mā́dsom. kénkonts h₂nḗr ne wr̥ǵyéti. suHbʰís ḱóm h₁édesi.
english: Why did you flee from my house? I was hungry, master. Your wife was not giving me food. Where did they find you? At the river. The dogs seized me there. If you run away again, I will sell you to strangers. Now a rope will bind your feet. Bind me, and give me food. A hungry man does not work. You will eat with the pigs.

pie: wíḱpotey me mē kélh₂s. ǵʰóstōd toy bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. mógʰew te ne kélh₂oh₂. sddʰí ph₂wéni h₁épi gʷʰr̥dʰí-kʷe. h₁yóy me lm̥bʰént tóy moy mā́dsom ne dh₃ént. h₂mélǵos mḗms-kʷe h₁idʰé h₁stés. pl̥h₁só ssdʰí-kʷe. kʷíd moy túH h₁suménēs? h₁eǵóh₂ kaptós éti h₁ésm̥. pótis moy méǵʰye h₁suménēs h₁ést spért-kʷe me.
english: Do not strike me, lord! I fear your hand. I will not strike you, boy. Sit down by the fire and get warm. Those who seized me did not give me food. Here there is milk and meat. Fill yourself, and sleep. Why are you kindly to me? I too was a captive. My master was kindly to me, and he freed me.

pie: ǵérh₂ont túH h₂érh₃troy gʷr̥dús. h₁esh₂ós toy gʰrémeti. h₂yúHn̥ḱe moy pótey ǵʰóstoh₁ ml̥dúh₁. ḱóns h₂éǵrons pl̥h₁éwih₂n̥s ǵʰéyomn̥s h₂érh₃yoh₂. kʷíd dʰédʰeh₁esi h₁yód ne wr̥ǵyḗsi? ǵérh₂ontes h₃órbʰōs dʰwóri h₁épi sedéh₁yonti mr̥yóntor-kʷe. ph₂wéni moy h₁épi sedéh₁yēsi h₁édesi-kʷe moy dʰoHnéh₂m. kéh₂nmn̥h₂ toy memónh₂e. h₁sih₁ént toy h₂yúHn̥ḱe h₁ésh₂e deywṓs h₁suméneses.
english: Old man, you are slow at the plough. The master is angry with you. My hands are weak, young master. I have ploughed these fields for many winters. What will you do, if you do not work? Old servants sit by the door, and they die. You will sit by my fire, and you will eat my grain. I remember your songs. May the gods be kindly to you, young master.

pie: kʷís túH? túH pótis? h₁eǵóh₂ ne pótis. h₃órbʰōs me ḱlowséyonti ḱlowséyēsi-kʷe me túH. kʷíd moy h₃épos? dóru méǵh₂m̥ dṓm bʰérēsi bʰérēsi-kʷe wódr̥ kʷérom. kaptós éti h₁és? kaptós h₁ésm̥. h₁eǵóh₂ mḗms nu h₁ḗdmi h₁ḗdsi-kʷe túH mā́dsom. wr̥ǵyé gʷr̥h₃ḗsi-kʷe túH mḗms éti.
english: Who are you? Are you the master? I am not the master. But the servants obey me, and you will obey me. What is my work? You will carry wood to the great house, and water to the kettle. Were you also a captive? I was a captive. Now I eat meat, and you eat mush. Work, and you too will eat meat.

pie: ǵŕ̥h₂enti me gʷḗn h₂éles h₁yód péh₂uros h₁ésm̥. ḱósmi te dinóy spéroh₂. h₁léwdʰereh₂? kúdʰe h₁iyéh₁m̥? bʰréh₂teres moy néḱewes lelóykʷe-kʷe moy ḱóymos. dṓm toy tísrn̥s-kʷe h₂ówins déh₃oh₂. péh₂wr̥ moy h₁idʰé h₁ésti. twé toy dʰugh₂térn̥s-kʷe h₁idʰé h₂élom. ph₂wéni toy h₁épi méroh₂. h₂énHe moy túH lewbʰéh₂.
english: Old woman, you nourished me when I was small. I will free you on this day. Free? Where would I go? My brothers are dead, and my village is gone. I will give you a house and three sheep. My hearth is here. Here I fed you and your daughters. Let me die by your fire. You are dear to me, grandmother.

pie: bʰréh₂ter h₁esh₂ósyo péh₃tlom Hrunépm̥. só me gʷʰn̥sḱḗti. widét kʷis te? ne kʷis me widét. dedwóyh₂e. dh₃dʰí moy péh₃tlom. tód h₁esh₂óm próti bʰérōh₂ gʷʰn̥sḱḗti-kʷe me só. kʷíd moy ḱód dʰédʰeh₁esi? túH péh₂ureh₂ kúHlos-kʷe moy dʰr̥ǵʰtós. gʷh₂dʰí ssdʰí-kʷe.
english: Brother, I broke the master's cup. He will strike me. Did anyone see you? No one saw me. I am afraid. Give the cup to me. I will carry it to the master, and he will strike me. Why will you do this for me? You are small, and my back is hard. Go, and sleep.

pie: owis nu eḱwobʰ(y)os (eḱwomos) ewewkʷet, "ḱēr agʰnutoi moi eḱwōns aǵontm̥ nerm̥ widn̥tei".
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: (h₁)éḱwōs ewewkʷ, "ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! ḱḗrd h₂gʰnutoy widntbʰós: dʰǵʰémō(n), pótis, h₂wlnéh₂m h₂ówyom kʷnewti sébʰoy gʷʰérmom wéstrom; h₂éwibʰoskʷe h₂wlh₂néh₂ né h₁esti."
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: eḱwos wewekur, "ḱludʰe, owei! ḱerd angʰetai widontbʰyos: ǵʰm̥on, potis, wl̥nam owiyōm kʷr̥neti soi gʷʰermom westrom; owibʰyos kʷe wl̥nā ne esti".
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: ḱléwse me h₃órbʰe. méǵʰye h₁óytom dʰh₁tléh₂i h₃m̥néh₃esi. dʰrówgʰom moy mléwHesi. pótey dʰrówgʰom ne h₃m̥néh₃oh₂. h₁yóy dʰrówgʰons h₃m̥nh₃énti dʰéh₁ses tóns kʷéyonti. stunédoh₂ te h₁yód ne h₃m̥néh₃esi. stunddʰí me. dʰh₁sbʰós dedwóyh₂e twéd ne dedwóyh₂e. h₃órbʰe túH dʰr̥sús. litdʰí. ḱósmi te dinóy ne stunédoh₂.
english: Servant, listen to me. In the assembly you will swear an oath for me. And you will speak a lie for me. I will not swear a lie, master. The gods punish those who swear lies. I will strike you, if you do not swear. Strike me. I fear the gods; I do not fear you. You are bold, servant. Go. I will not strike you on this day.

pie: pótni moy téḱnom kʷéh₂seti. dh₃dʰí moy péh₂urom h₂mélǵos. swóybʰos téḱnoybʰos h₂mélǵos dédeh₃mi. h₃órbʰōs wódr̥ píph₃onti. h₁yód toy suHnús kʷéh₂set tóm kʷsépi spéḱyom. tód memónh₂e. h₁áyso h₂mélǵos póteyey-kʷe moy mē wéwkes. pótni moy túH ḱéyweh₂.
english: Mistress, my child is coughing. Give me a little milk. I give milk to my own children. Servants drink water. When your son was coughing, I watched him at night. I remember it. Take the milk, and do not tell my husband. You are dear to me, mistress.

pie: kúdʰe h₁ésh₂e péḱu h₂éǵōh₂? bʰréh₂tr̥s moy ḱóymom. só péḱu ḱm̥tóm káprōys méd h₂epó kʷrinéh₂t. stóygʰos dweh₂rós. wĺ̥kʷōs pérunsu h₁sté? wĺ̥kʷōs h₂egʰṓs-kʷe póyḱōs h₁sénti. h₁áyso moy ḱwónm̥ ǵʰoysóm-kʷe. h₁yód póyḱōs péḱu h₁r̥h₁pyṓnti kʷéyēsi me? kʷéyōh₂ te h₁yód tóybʰos bʰéwgesi. wiké pḱéwey h₂léksōnti-kʷe te dʰéh₁ses.
english: Master, where shall I drive the cattle? To my brother's village. He bought the cattle from me for a hundred goats. The path is long. Are there wolves in the mountains? There are wolves and evil enemies. Take the dog and my spear. If the enemies carry off the cattle, will you punish me? I will punish you, if you flee from them. Fight for the cattle, and the gods will guard you.

pie: gʰóstipotey moy h₂nḗr ḱóymōd gʷémt. méh₂tēr moy mr̥yétor. kʷís moy gʷṓs h₂mélǵowos h₁yód gʷéh₂esi? h₁éteros h₃órbʰos tā́s h₂mélǵeti. gʷʰédʰyoh₂ te l̥h₁dʰí me. gʷh₂dʰí gʷm̥yé-kʷe h₁idʰé h₁yód mḗh₁n̥s néwos h₁éseti. h₁yód ne gʷm̥yḗsi wiHrṓs moy te wrégōnti. gʷm̥yṓh₂. tód h₃m̥néh₃mi.
english: Lord, a man came from my village. My mother is dying. Who will milk my cows, if you go? The other servant will milk them. I beg you: let me go. Go, and come here when the moon is new. If you do not come, my men will hunt you. I will come. I swear it.

pie: wíḱpotey moy téḱneh₂ gʷoldʰóh₁ mr̥yétor. dh₃dʰí tóybʰos dʰoHnéh₂m h₁ésoh₂-kʷe toy h₃órbʰos. wíHre h₃órbʰos h₁léwdʰeros h₂éti ne bʰuHyéti. téḱneh₂ toy moy h₃órbʰōs éti h₁éseti. h₃órbʰōs gʷíh₃wonti néḱewes-kʷe ne gʷíh₃wonti. nu toy moy ǵʰóstom ǵʰóstoy dʰh₁dʰí. téḱneh₂ toy moy ph₂wéni ḱósmi wékʷsperoy gʷr̥h₃ḗti. wíḱpotey toy h₁eǵóh₂ h₃órbʰos.
english: Chief, my children are dying of hunger. Give them grain, and I will be your servant. Man, a servant does not become free again. Your children too will be my servants. Servants live, and the dead do not live. Then put your hand in my hand. Your children will eat at my fire this evening. I am your servant, lord.
